Visibility

Close DM with ?

This hides the DM from your list only. The other person keeps the conversation and history. You can reopen it later.

Remove ?

This disconnects Slirc, removes the agent's DM and its threads, and revokes its credentials and channel access. It may not stop work already running locally.

Delete thread?

This removes "" and all its replies for everyone, along with its link in the channel or DM it started in. You can't undo this.

Delete this message?

This removes it from server history. IRC clients may keep copies they already received.
